items.name: Meridian Ledger
items.desc: A treasury dashboard that makes cash flow legible at a glance.
items.full: Built with React, TypeScript, and Recharts. Features real-time cash flow tracking, multi-account aggregation, and a custom charting layer that handles irregular payment cadences without visual noise. Delivered in 6 weeks for a Series B fintech.

items.name: Nova Design System
items.desc: Component library and token architecture for a SaaS product suite.
items.full: A token-first design system spanning 80+ components across 3 product surfaces. Built with Tailwind, Radix, and Storybook. Reduced cross-team design inconsistencies by 60% in the first quarter after adoption.

items.name: Pulse Analytics
items.desc: Real-time data visualisation platform for fintech operations teams.
items.full: WebSocket-driven dashboard with 15+ chart types, drill-down capabilities, and a configurable alert engine. Handles 10k+ events per second in the browser using a rolling buffer architecture with React, D3, and a custom render scheduler.
